title: Real Time Data Services
description: myrealdata.in Real Time Data Services Pvt Ltd (RTDS) is an Indian IT group founded in 2010 and headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana, providing cloud hosting, cybersecurity and cloud telephony worldwide. Led by co-founder and MD Vinay Chhabra, a former Principal Director General of GST and IIT alumnus, and co-founder Dr Sangeeta Chhabra, it employs over 600 people and serves 8000 plus customers in six plus countries. Its three brands are AceCloud, an Indian sovereign public cloud with GPU and DeepSeek AI models, Ace Cloud Hosting in Florida, a QuickBooks hosting leader for US accountants, and Acefone, a cloud telephony platform handling six billion calls a year in 150 countries. Certified to ISO 27001 and 20000 and a Microsoft, Intuit and AWS partner, it counts Fortis, Godrej, SAP, Cipla and OLA among clients. Awards include the 2024 Stevie Award and CPA Practice Advisor best outsourced provider. Revenue runs 100 to 500 crore rupees with 4000 servers and ten data center partnerships.
